Shelter Shell.name: Shelter Shell
Shelter Shell.description: The user kneels, spreads both arms and pours out a dome of foam-lined steel over themselves and the people beside them, wide enough for a small group. Until it is cut or blasted open, gunfire, falling debris, flame and smoke cannot reach anyone inside, a collapse cannot crush them, and the user can open a hatch in it from within. Strain: heavy.
